svg.aria-label: Five Jetson AGX Thor developer kits on one shelf, named thor-1 to thor-5, with the cluster addresses 10.10.0.11 to 10.10.0.15. Each has a QSFP28 breakout cable, at 25 gigabits a second for each lane, to a 25 GbE switch above them: this is the cluster network. Each also has an ordinary Ethernet cable from its RJ45 port to the house network below, which carries internet access, ssh and Tailscale. Your laptop and Tailscale reach the Thors through the house network.
svg.text: The fast network joins the Thors to each other. The house network joins them to you.
ONE SHELF · FIVE JETSON AGX THOR
25 GbE switch, SFP28 ports · the cluster network, 10.10.0.0/24
The house network: your router, or a small switch beside it
ssh thor-3, at home or away
